task_instance: Scaffold a minimal polyglot Aspire distributed application via `aspire new aspire-starter` (the skill's core deliverable: create/orchestrate an Aspire AppHost project) and run it locally with `aspire run`.
blocker_detail: The Aspire CLI (v13.5.4, installed and working: `aspire --version` succeeds) and Docker (daemon started successfully, `docker info` OK) are both present, so scaffolding got as far as project-template resolution. `aspire new aspire-starter -n TestApp -o TestApp --non-interactive` fails with 'No template versions were found. Please check your internet connection or NuGet source configuration.' Root cause traced via the CLI's debug log and a direct reproduction with `dotnet new install Aspire.ProjectTemplates` (also fails: 'no NuGet feeds are configured or they are invalid'). NuGet's v3 service index (https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json, itself reachable, HTTP 200) lists required sub-resources on azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org and azuresearch-ussc.nuget.org (the SearchQueryService used to resolve/search template packages). The sandbox's egress proxy explicitly denies CONNECT to both of these hosts with HTTP 403 ('policy denial'), confirmed via `curl http://127.0.0.1:40457/__agentproxy/status` which logs repeated `connect_rejected ... gateway answered 403 to CONNECT ... host: azuresearch-ussc.nuget.org:443` and `azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org:443`. Per the proxy README, a 403 policy denial should be reported, not retried or worked around. Without resolving the NuGet template package, no AppHost project can be scaffolded, so the skill's core deliverable (create and run an Aspire distributed app) could not be exercised.
evidence: Environment check: `which dotnet docker aspire` -> all present; `dotnet --version` -> 10.0.112; `aspire --version` -> 13.5.4+9c1b401dd67746739044f68959cbf4d3d7af93a6. Started dockerd (was not running) and verified with `docker info` (Server responded, Containers/Images listed). Ran `aspire new aspire-starter -n TestApp -o TestApp --non-interactive --nologo --skill-locations none --log-level Debug` -> exit code 4, log shows 'Stderr: No template versions were found. Please check your internet connection or NuGet source configuration.' Reproduced independently with `dotnet new install Aspire.ProjectTemplates` -> 'Aspire.ProjectTemplates could not be installed, no NuGet feeds are configured or they are invalid.' Confirmed `dotnet nuget list source` shows nuget.org configured correctly. Fetched https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json and parsed its 'resources' array, finding required search endpoints hosted on azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org / azuresearch-ussc.nuget.org. Queried the sandbox's own diagnostic endpoint `curl http://127.0.0.1:40457/__agentproxy/status`, which lists recentRelayFailures entries: {"kind":"connect_rejected","detail":"gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)","host":"azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org:443"} and the same for azuresearch-ussc.nuget.org, timestamps matching the failed aspire/dotnet commands. No project files were produced (TestApp/ remains empty).
